exposure: extracellular vesicle (EV) miRNA in maternal plasma collected in early pregnancy (median: 12.5 weeks)
extracellular vesicle (EV) miRNA in maternal plasma collected in late pregnancy (median: 31.8 weeks)
cohort: The study included 156 participants from the MADRES Study, a health disparity pregnancy cohort.
finding: Late pregnancy measures of 13 miRNA were associated with gestational age at birth, and sex-specific associations were observed for early pregnancy measures of 37 miRNA and gestational age at birth, suggesting that EV miRNA in both early and late pregnancy may influence gestational duration.
